authoritative_success_condition: PASS only if Q0-Q10 all pass under both the producer qualification and the separate independent checker. Any disagreement or unsupported structure is assurance-incomplete for qualification; no gate may be downgraded after observing results.

correction_principle.description: v0.2 strengthens enforcement and corrects Q6 from a syntactically overconstrained per-anchor-owning-scope branch requirement to the semantic requirement actually needed by the frozen D2 design: a complete, explicit control-consumption chain from the frozen guard value to a branch-bearing guard that controls the consequential path.

authorized: freeze seed-only D1/D2/D3 implementation and authoritative receipts
pre-register a separate mutation-blind anchor-transport protocol

Q0_CLOSED_READ_SET.requirement: Primary and independent-checker code paths must have a closed, auditable read set containing only allowed inputs. No forbidden source may be opened or parsed.

Q10_DETERMINISM.requirement: Two primary executions and two independent-checker executions within the authoritative run must be byte-identical for their respective canonical outputs.

Q1_BASE_BINDING.requirement: Each canonical seed overlay binds exact frozen A2 v0.1 base_ir_digest_sha256 and exact acquired seed sha256. model.py and ir.py Git blob identities must equal the frozen authorities.

Q2_DEFINITION_IDENTITY_COVERAGE.requirement: For every supported frontend FUNCTION parameter, ASSIGN lhs, FIELD_BIND write, and CALL result required by the seed subset, the overlay must contain a distinct provenance-bearing value/definition instance at the exact structural site. Distinct definition sites may not share a definition_site_key.

fixture_families.assertion: return lineage contains the second x definition and excludes the first
fixture_families.shape: parameter a,b; x=a; x=b; return x

fixture_families.assertion: post-join return lineage contains both reaching x definitions as an explicit alternative set
fixture_families.shape: parameter flag,a,b; x=a; if flag: x=b; return x

fixture_families.assertion: field-value identities remain distinct and are bound to distinct representation_instance_id values
fixture_families.shape: construct two representation instances with the same field key from distinct source parameters

Q3_REACHING_DEFINITION_MECHANICS.language_coverage: Each fixture family must execute through Python, Go, and TypeScript/JavaScript supported frontends, or the qualification must explicitly fail closed for a language.
Q3_REACHING_DEFINITION_MECHANICS.requirement: In addition to canonical-seed inspection, mutation-free structural mechanics fixtures must demonstrate (a) a definite straight-line rewrite kills the old reaching definition, (b) a branch join preserves both predecessor reaching definitions without synthetic collapse, and (c) same-named representation fields on distinct representation instances remain distinct. These fixtures carry no consequence truth or expected A3/A4 verdict.

Q4_REPRESENTATION_AND_CALL_BINDING.requirement: Representation-field values must carry representation-instance identity. For every uniquely acquired supported call in the analyzed seed path, exact actual-to-formal BINDS_TO and function-return-to-call-result DERIVES relations must be present. Nested call results crossing an argument boundary must retain exact argument_index.

Q5_EXACT_ANCHOR_MATERIALIZATION.requirement: All 18 frozen anchors must resolve to nodes whose role, exact span, source sha256, anchor-contract digest, and frozen slice_sha256 agree with the frozen anchor declaration. The 12 frozen operand slots must each resolve to exactly one existing versioned value instance and BINDS_TO the declared guard operand index.

Q6_COMPLETE_CONTROL_CONSUMPTION_CHAIN.requirement: Every frozen consequence path must have COMPLETE parser/validated-structure control scopes and explicit ENTRY/EXIT/PRECEDES structure. Every frozen guard anchor must satisfy one of two forms: DIRECT_CONTROL, where that guard itself has both true and false GUARDS edges; or HELPER_CONTROL, where a provenance-bearing DERIVES/BINDS_TO/CARRIES/COMPARES chain through uniquely resolved return/call-result flow reaches a branch-bearing consumer GUARD with both polarities. All scopes on a HELPER_CONTROL chain must be COMPLETE. The consequential EFFECT/SUCCESS and REJECTION outcomes must be connected by PRECEDES to the relevant branch/control path. Raw line order alone is never sufficient.

Q7_NO_LINE_ORDER_SEMANTICS.requirement: Independent source audit must confirm source line/column values are used only for provenance, containment, and deterministic output ordering, not as sole execution/control authority.

Q8_INDEPENDENT_CONTENT_ADDRESS_AND_GRAPH.requirement: A checker separate from the overlay producer must recompute every overlay node id from {kind,label,span,attrs}, every edge id from {kind,source,target,span,attrs}, each overlay_digest_sha256, and bundle_digest_sha256; verify all endpoints exist; and independently require EVIDENCED_BY for every non-EVIDENCE node.

Q9_CLAIM_BOUNDARY.requirement: Outputs remain semantic_authority=false and D1/D2/D3 observability only. No regression/stability/safety verdict or fresh-target claim is present.
